raw/train.subject_id: Globally namespaced patient ID; repeated at every CGM timepoint
raw/train.Timestamp: Original observed local wall-clock time, sorted, no resampling
raw/train.label: HbA1c-derived patient class, identical to labels CSV
raw/train.hba1c: Patient HbA1c using project percent convention; an outcome, not a covariate
raw/train.sensor_code: Source nonnumeric glucose token, blank when numeric
raw/train.source_file: Member path inside original source archive
raw/train.source_row: Physical CSV line including header line 1

clinical_metadata.gender: Source FEMALE/MALE, not currently a v1.2.0 model feature
clinical_metadata.age,bmi,height_cm,weight_kg: Absent in source; blank, not zero or inferred
clinical_metadata.source_dob_text_unverified: Device birth-date text, retained for audit only, not verified clinical DOB

raw_train_folder: Storage convention only; does not constitute an assigned training split
